observed.name: Observed
observed.means: Python itself recorded this from your code, running in your browser. The header says which version of Python.

derived.name: Derived
derived.means: Worked out from observed facts using Python’s rules. True for your code, but not recorded directly.

reference.name: Reference
reference.means: Real, but prepared in advance rather than taken from your run: CPython’s own source code, or recordings on our test machine.

illustrative.name: Illustrative
illustrative.means: A made-up example that shows the kind of thing that happens. Not real data from your program.

typical.name: Typical
typical.means: How it usually works, for example on a Linux terminal. Your computer may do it differently.
